summary: The Harvard LEAD Fellowship for Promoting Women in Global Health, run by the Harvard Global Health Institute, supports senior global health leaders from low- and middle-income countries. The fellowship runs from 1 September 2027 to 31 August 2028 in a hybrid format, including a six-week in-person experience in Cambridge, MA, in spring 2028.
highlights: For professionals from a low- or middle-income country who hold at least a master's degree.
At least 10 years of full-time professional work in global health beyond education, plus substantial leadership experience.
Applicants must be able to obtain a J-1 visa.
Runs 1 September 2027 to 31 August 2028, with six weeks in person in Cambridge, MA, in spring 2028.
